limits: All seven outputs are newly generated individual raster images; no upscaling or synthetic animation.
Original model materials and broad anatomy guide the candidates; fine geometry, poses and opposite-side details are not certified one-to-one.
Mirroring is a runtime presentation transform, not an independently generated reverse angle.
Native dimensions are recorded per file; no native UHD/4K claim.
The Fighter references show the covered final outfit; anatomy-only turntable images are excluded from its generation.
